note_en: 随着… means "as… / along with…" and sets up a gradual change: 随着水分慢慢蒸发，锅贴的底部会变得越来越脆 "as the water slowly evaporates, the bottoms of the potstickers get crispier and crispier." It often pairs with 越来越 ("more and more"), which goes right before the adjective, where English would repeat the comparative.
